title: 436. Count Numbers with Unique Digits

examples.explanation: All numbers from 0 to 99 except 11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88 and 99 have distinct digits.

hints: Count numbers by exact length: the first digit has 9 choices (no leading zero) and each later digit has one fewer choice.
Add the length-1 counts for all lengths from 1 up to n, plus 1 for zero itself.
Lengths beyond 10 cannot have unique digits, but n is at most 8 here.
